fields.System.Title: TRF-102 — Validate stock at origin
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a network planner, I want to be told when the origin cannot supply what I asked for,
so that I do not raise a transfer that will fail at picking.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a transfer line, then available quantity at the origin is checked and shown at
  • creation.
  • - Given insufficient stock, then the transfer is still created but the line is flagged
  • as unfulfillable.
  • - Given the check, then it excludes quarantined, damaged, blocked-location, and expired
  • stock.
  • - Given the check at creation, then it is advisory — the binding check happens at
  • allocation in [TRF-201](TRF-201-allocate-and-pick.md).
  • - Given stock that disappears between creation and allocation, then allocation fails
  • cleanly with a clear reason.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory |
| Tables | transfer_line, stock_balance |
| Risks | Origin stock gone by picking time ([doc 09 §4.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
